title: The Little Cloud Who Wanted to Rain
author: Hamidreza Rostami
moral_lesson: Letting go takes courage — and it can turn you into something beautiful.
short_description: A timid little cloud learns that letting go can be the bravest thing of all.
long_description: Nimbus is a small cloud who loves floating in the sky, but he is terrified of raining. While all the other clouds joyfully water the world below, Nimbus holds himself together tightly, afraid he will disappear. But when he sees a thirsty garden and a sad little sparrow, he must find the courage to help. Through this gentle adventure, Nimbus discovers that letting go does not mean disappearing — it means becoming part of something beautiful. A heartwarming story about courage, self-confidence, and the joy of giving.
